attributes.morphology: dendrite enriched with W and Ta; interdendrite enriched with Ti

evidence.quote: SEM images (Fig. 1 b-d) manifest large grains with dendritic structures inside. The results of EDS suggest that the dendrite was enriched with W and Ta, while the interdendrite was enriched with Ti, and Nb/Mo were evenly distributed.

evidence.quote: The high-strength W0.4MoNbxTaTi HEAs benefit from severe lattice distortion caused by different elements randomly occupying lattice positions. The shear stress of dislocation slip increases due to the hindrance of lattice distortion, which reveals the high yield stress of HEAs.

The yield stress exhibited a pronounced decrease as the testing temperature increased to 1073 K and 1273 K, which was attributed to the energy provided by the high temperature. The higher energy would promote the movement of dislocations and even grain boundaries, leading to the reduction of yield strength.

mechanisms.name: crack initiation and propagation at grain boundaries

evidence.quote: As the picture shows, the cracks were initiated at the grain boundaries (GBs) and then propagated along the GBs, meanwhile, some cracks expanded into the grains. As the temperature elevated, the propagation of cracks was suppressed.
